import numpy as np, mujoco, rcb_dtb
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
s=rcb_dtb.Session('/app/instance.json'); m=s.model; d=s.data
palm=m.body('palmworld').id
startR=d.xmat[palm].reshape(3,3).copy(); startP=d.xpos[palm].copy()
qhome=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q[:7].copy()
def ik(pos,R,qseed=None,maxiter=70):
    q=(d.qpos[s._jq[:7]].copy() if qseed is None else qseed.copy())
    for _ in range(maxiter):
        d.qpos[s._jq[:7]]=q; mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
        cp=d.xpos[palm].copy();cR=d.xmat[palm].reshape(3,3).copy()
        err=np.r_[pos-cp,Rot.from_matrix(R@cR.T).as_rotvec()]
        if np.linalg.norm(err[:3])<.0004 and np.linalg.norm(err[3:])<.004:break
        jp=np.zeros((3,m.nv));jr=np.zeros((3,m.nv));mujoco.mj_jacBody(m,d,jp,jr,palm)
        J=np.r_[jp[:,s._jv[:7]],jr[:,s._jv[:7]]]
        dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.002*np.eye(6),err)
        q=np.clip(q+np.clip(dq,-.12,.12),s.lower[:7],s.upper[:7])
    return q,np.linalg.norm(err)
def hand(curl=0,thumb=0):
    h=np.zeros(22)
    h[0]=thumb;h[2]=min(1.3,thumb);h[4]=thumb
    for i in [5,9,13,18]:h[i]=curl
    for i in [7,11,15,20]:h[i]=min(1.7,curl*1.25)
    for i in [8,12,16,21]:h[i]=min(1.4,curl*1.0)
    h[17]=.1
    return h
# restore because IK works directly on state
s.reset();s.record_start()
def move(q0,q1,h0,h1,n):
    for t in range(n):
        a=(t+1)/n; a=a*a*(3-2*a)
        p=s.step(np.r_[q0*(1-a)+q1*a,h0*(1-a)+h1*a])
    return p
q0=rcb_dtb.INIT_Q[:7].copy();h0=np.zeros(22)
q1,e=ik(np.array([.07,.22,.62]),startR,q0);print('IK',q1,e,flush=True)
s.reset();s.record_start()
move(q0,q1,h0,h0,150)
print('approach',s.state()['object_pos'],s.state()['palm_pos'],s.progress(),flush=True)
move(q1,q1,h0,hand(1.15,1.0),130)
print('grasp',s.state()['object_pos'],s.progress(),flush=True)
q2,e=ik(np.array([.07,.22,.73]),startR,q1)
s.data.qpos[s._jq[:7]]=q1;mujoco.mj_forward(m,d)
move(q1,q2,hand(1.15,1.0),hand(1.15,1.0),120)
print('lift',s.state()['object_pos'],s.state()['object_quat_wxyz'],s.progress(),flush=True)
A=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(A)
